technique_name: L1.1.1 Side Channel Attack > L1.1.1.1 Time analysis, power consumption analysis, electromagnetic radiation analysis, etc.

technique_name: L1.1.2 Fault injection attacks > L1.1.2.1 Voltage injection, clock injection, electromagnetic injection, temperature injection
description: By exploiting faults (such as voltage, clock, etc.) that cause abnormalities in the circuit, sensitive information inside the chip can be analyzed based on the abnormal information. Alternatively, the induced circuit abnormalities can be directly used to alter program execution, etc.
potential_defenses: Redundancy technology, digital sensor technology, special packaging technology, etc.
code_examples_patterns: Capture power/electromagnetic signals during cryptographic operations
Inject voltage/clock glitch to bypass authentication check

technique_name: L1.1.3 Physical Attack > L1.1.3.1 FIB circuit modification/probe attack, board-level wiring tampering/probe eavesdropping, system-level attack
description: Remove the chip packaging, establish electrical contact with the internal circuitry, and combine other attack methods to obtain sensitive information stored within the chip.
resource_required: Focused ion beam (FIB), scanning electron microscope (SEM)
potential_defenses: Passive shield, active shield, signal integrity protection, etc.
code_examples_patterns: Modify protected data region with root access to bypass lock
related_tools: Focused ion beam (FIB), scanning electron microscope (SEM)

technique_name: C1.1.3 Key information disclosure > C1.1.3.1 Credential Disclosure on the Cloud Platform
description: The cloud platform serves as the foundation for cloud services (container services, VM services). If the Access Key or login credentials of the cloud platform are leaked, attackers will gain the authority to control the entire cluster.
potential_defenses:
1. If the service code needs to be authenticated and communicate with the cloud service by using credentials such as AccessKey, consider creating a subaccount for each cloud service and minimizing permissions. In addition, use the authorization management function of the cloud platform if available. (for example, IAM of  CLOUD and RAM of  Cloud) To implement rights-based management and unified resource management for different users.
2. The administrator must strictly confirm the code hosting to avoid the disclosure of related credentials.
Use secret management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) instead of hardcoded credentials
detection_opportunities: 1. Verify whether there are exposed credentials in the managed code by means such as regular expression matching.
code_examples_patterns: Extract credentials from leaked configuration files
Authenticate with harvested credentials to target service

technique_name: C1.1.3 Key information disclosure > C1.1.3.2 Leak of SSH login credentials for the primary node
description: A common method for managing container clusters is by logging into the Master node or an operations jump server, and then using the kubectl command-line tool to control Kubernetes (K8s). In this scenario, if the SSH credentials of the front-end node are leaked or compromised, the K8s cluster will also be exposed to risks.
potential_defenses:
1. When permitted, establish SSH connections solely through private key authentication. Otherwise, avoid using the product's default SSH login credentials.
2. When administrators perform code hosting, they must conduct strict verification to prevent the leakage of related credentials.
Restrict service exposure using firewall rules and network segmentation
Use secret management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) instead of hardcoded credentials
detection_opportunities: 1. Verify whether there are exposed credentials in the managed code by means such as regular expression matching.

code_examples_patterns: Port scan to discover exposed service endpoints

technique_name: M1.1.1 Hardware Detachment Attack > M1.1.1.1 JTAG Port Attack

potential_defenses: It is strictly prohibited to directly expose the JTAG port. On the PCB version, there should be no debugging port silkscreen next to the port.
Disable debug ports in production firmware builds
detection_opportunities: Physical security logs showing unauthorized JTAG device connection
